run_train_xor: run the train_xor function to train an XOR neural network with CUPTI GPU profiling enabled
create_Xor_model: create an Xor neural network module with two linear layers for binary XOR classification
configure_cupti_profiler: configure torch.profiler.profile with CUPTI metrics like tensor_core_insts and dram bytes read and write
export_chrome_trace: export the profiler results to a Chrome trace JSON file using export_chrome_trace
summarize_ExperimentalConfig: summarize the _ExperimentalConfig class used to set profiler_metrics and profiler_measure_per_kernel options
